newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Ausdoc plans A$5.1 mln share buy-back.
newsitem.headline: Ausdoc plans A$5.1 mln share buy-back.

text.p: Business service group Ausdoc Group Ltd said on Wednesday it planned to buy back a further 2.56 million ordinary shares which, based on current prices, would cost about A$5.1 million.
The share buy-back programme would be funded from operating cashflows and current facilities, Ausdoc said.

Ausdoc said during the initial buy back, which ends on June 27, 1997, Ausdoc bought back 2.54 million shares or about 4.45 percent of its issued capital prior. These shares had been purchased at an average price of A$1.92.

"In parallel with this buy-back program, Ausdoc will continue to seek out opportunities to acquire businesses which either fit with Ausdoc's core DX and Information Management divisions, or are logical extensions of those businesses," Ausdoc said.
At 3.50 p.m. (0550 GMT), Ausdoc shares were one cent up at A$2.01.
